import argparse
import re
import sys

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--spec")
PATTERN = re.compile(r"^SPEC:[a-z]+$")

def evaluate(payload):
    required = payload["spec"]
    optional = payload.get("mode")
    if not required:
        return False, "missing spec"
    if optional == "deny":
        sys.exit(3)
    dynamic = f"{required}:{optional}"
    return {"status": "ok", "path": "loop-team/specs/example.md", "dynamic": dynamic}
